description: Export a file-verified still image. PNG stills keep the sequence's transparency (straight alpha, reported as hasAlpha); composite them over black before measuring brightness or comparing with a video render. A single still does not verify motion over time, playback or audio.

output_path.description: Full output file path (e.g., '/Users/me/frame.png'). Extension determines format.

time_seconds.description: Time position in seconds to export. Uses current playhead if omitted.

name: export_frame

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Export Frame
